canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Orders pressure, temperature, open-flow CO2, open-flow H2O, QC, review, write gate, reverify, and archive without opening COM by default.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: Do not use it as a hidden real-device runner; it is the formal sequence contract and supervised planner.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Owns the formal initialization contract: device-ID binding, GETCO1-9 epoch-0 snapshot, S5/S6/S7/S8/S9 gates, startup acquisition settings, readiness, pre-gas gap list, and database evidence indexing.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: This is the single formal initialization entrypoint. It plans and gates; subordinate probe/writer/readiness tools do the authorized read-only or controlled-write work and historical logs remain traceability evidence only.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Verifies analyzer pressure P against COM22/PACE before CO2/H2O fitting so pressure error is not absorbed into gas coefficients.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: Pressure fitting and SENCO9 handling are separate from CO2/H2O concentration fitting.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Reviews chamber/case temperature behavior against temperature evidence before interpreting multi-temperature gas response.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: Temperature review is not an automatic temperature coefficient write.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Collects clean open-flow CO2 data while standard gas continuously refreshes the analyzer cavity and downstream line.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: Do not include sealed-pressure, VENT-hold, or dynamic-pressure diagnostic rows in the formal CO2 fit.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Collects open-flow H2O data with dewpoint/reference evidence so dry-gas and wet-gas anchors remain physically interpretable.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: Dry-gas low-water evidence is not automatically the same thing as CO2 zero-gas evidence.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Builds candidate coefficients from eligible A-grade open-flow samples and preserves rejected points with reasons.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: Candidate generation is no-write; diagnostic rows and rejected rows stay outside formal fit eligibility by default.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Checks old coefficients, candidate coefficients, residuals, blockers, and reviewer evidence before any SENCO write.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: A review artifact is not authorization to write; controlled-write tools remain separate.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Writes CO2 main-chain coefficients only after identity, old-coefficient snapshot, candidate review, and readback plan are available.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: Never run as a background evidence or report step; H2O, pressure, and linear-trim writes use their own controlled tools.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Confirms written coefficients against independent reverify samples before release.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: A coefficient write without post-write reverify remains incomplete for formal release.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Closes the run evidence chain with artifact hashes, reports, database index inputs, and traceability status.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: Archive closure does not change device state and must not hide rejected frames or points.

canonical_formal_path.physical_meaning: Summarizes current stage, next action, physical-flow continuation, and formal archive/database release readiness from existing sidecars.
canonical_formal_path.safety_boundary: Formal run status is read-only evidence; it must not open COM, connect PostgreSQL, control routes, or write analyzer state.
